method.scope: Nine hardware configurations reused by Manual, Hybrid and Auto; this is selected accelerator-component area, not whole-chip area.
method.total_definition: cell_area_library_units already includes SRAM; logic = cell area - SRAM. Net Interconnect area in DC report_area is excluded.
method.hierarchy: references.rpt supplies per-design global cell area at six decimal places. area.rpt maps hierarchical instance paths to designs. Direct SRAM references in each design are counted through the hierarchy and multiplied by sram.tsv macro unit areas.
method.disjointness: Every layer is an included subtree or an explicit parent-minus-children difference. Configuration totals add only layers, never both a parent and its included descendants.
method.precision: Reports print finite decimal precision. SRAM unit-rounding residuals (at most 0.00002 library units per component) are assigned to the largest storage layer; original component SRAM and total area are preserved. All adjustments are recorded.
method.ownership: ClockSinkDomain_6 is Gemmini-owned MMIO/CDC/publication logic; ClockSinkDomain_7 onward is per-CGRA MMIO/CDC. ClockSinkDomain_4 is shared scheduling and fabric-side endpoint CDC. ClockSinkDomain_5 is shared profile/run control and storage. ClockSinkDomain_3 includes external SPM and its local bridges/crossbars.
method.core_labels: Core logic includes compute, local routing, native control and storage peripheral logic; it is not pure arithmetic. Gemmini native load/store DMA and TLB remain in native core. The separate CGRA native serial DMA is assigned to its adapter.
method.storage_labels: SRAM means mapped SRAM macros only. Register arrays, FIFOs and control stores implemented as standard cells remain logic. Adapter SRAM is separate from data/core SRAM.
method.name_mapping: This frozen P1 RTL uses AutoScheduler/AutoStage, GemminiLinkAdapter and CgraLinkAdapter. AutoLinkCore/NativeGemminiAdapter/NativeCGRAAdapter are conceptual names, not the archived module names.
method.excluded: CPU/Rocket, caches, global system TileLink fabric, DRAM controller, full clock/reset distribution, pads and whole-chip physical routing are outside the selected component index. Local TileLink blocks inside selected components are included.
method.hierarchical_override: ResNet4 ClockSinkDomain_4 uses frozen standalone AutoStage mappings. Its complete parent area is counted once; subtree areas are not added separately. This mapping can differ from original cross-boundary optimization.
method.simulation: Synthesis-only SRAM adaptations are not the unchanged simulator hardware; area and cycles do not constitute one validated implementation.
